model_annotations.Bulgarian:
Фигура 4 илюстрира промените в средните абсолютни стойности на скрити състояния (hidden states) по слоеве на модел, като сравнява три различни условия. Заглавието на графиката е "Hidden State Mean".

Оста X е обозначена като "Layer" и представя номерата на слоевете с линейна скала. Диапазонът обхваща стойности от 0 до приблизително 22, с етикети, разположени през интервали от 5 единици (0, 5, 10, 15, 20).

Оста Y е обозначена като "Abs Mean" и използва линейна скала. Диапазонът обхваща стойности от 0 до приблизително 4.5, с етикети, разположени през интервали от 1 единица (0, 1, 2, 3, 4).

Първата линия, обозначена като "Hidden state mean before gate, avg 0.71", е в зелен цвят с пунктиран стил и кръгли маркери. Тя започва от стойност близо до 0 при слой 0, нараства рязко до връх от приблизително 4.3 около слой 3–4, след което спада стръмно до около 1.0 при слой 7–8 и продължава да намалява постепенно, като се стабилизира около 0.2–0.3 в по-дълбоките слоеве (от слой 10 до слой 22).

Втората линия, обозначена като "Hidden state mean after gate, avg 0.05", е в оранжев цвят с пунктиран стил и триъгълни маркери. Тя остава много близо до 0 по цялата дължина на оста X, от слой 0 до слой 22, без видими значителни върхове или спадове.

Третата линия, обозначена като "Hidden state mean of baseline, avg 0.04", е в син цвят с плътен стил и без ясно различими маркери. Тя също остава много близо до 0 по цялата дължина на оста X, от слой 0 до слой 22, като визуално се припокрива почти изцяло с оранжевата линия.

Легендата е разположена в горната дясна част на графиката и съдържа описанията на трите линии заедно с техните средни стойности (avg 0.71, avg 0.05 и avg 0.04 съответно).
model_annotations.Chinese: This figure, titled "Hidden State Mean," displays the mean absolute values of hidden states across layers, comparing conditions before and after gating as well as a baseline. The x-axis is labeled "Layer" with a linear scale ranging from 0 to approximately 22, with major tick marks at intervals of 5 (0, 5, 10, 15, 20). The y-axis is labeled "Abs Mean" with a linear scale ranging from 0 to approximately 4.5, with major tick marks at intervals of 1 (0, 1, 2, 3, 4). Three lines are shown in the figure. The first line, depicted in green with a dashed line style and circular markers, represents "Hidden state mean before gate, avg 0.71"; it starts near 0 at layer 0, rises sharply to a peak of approximately 4.3 around layer 6, then decreases steeply to around 0.5 by layer 10, and continues to decline gradually, remaining below approximately 0.3 through layer 22. The second line, shown in orange with a dashed line style and triangular markers, represents "Hidden state mean after gate, avg 0.05"; it remains very close to 0 across all layers, staying nearly flat from layer 0 through layer 22 with only minimal fluctuation. The third line, depicted in blue with a solid line style and no distinct markers, represents "Hidden state mean of baseline, avg 0.04"; it also remains very close to 0 throughout all layers, closely overlapping with the orange line from layer 0 to layer 22.
model_annotations.English: This plot illustrates the mean absolute values of hidden states across layers, comparing conditions before and after gating as well as a baseline. The x-axis is labeled "Layer" with a linear scale ranging from 0 to approximately 22, with tick marks at intervals of 5 (0, 5, 10, 15, 20). The y-axis is labeled "Abs Mean" with a linear scale ranging from 0 to approximately 4.5, with tick marks at intervals of 1 (0, 1, 2, 3, 4). Three lines are shown. The first, depicted as a green dashed line with circular markers, represents "Hidden state mean before gate, avg 0.71"; it starts near 0 at layer 0, rises sharply to a peak of approximately 4.3 around layer 6, then declines steeply to around 0.5 by layer 10, and continues to decrease gradually, remaining below approximately 0.3 through the later layers. The second line, shown as an orange dashed line with triangular markers, represents "Hidden state mean after gate, avg 0.05"; it remains very close to 0 across all layers, with only slight fluctuations barely visible above the baseline. The third line, depicted as a solid blue line, represents "Hidden state mean of baseline, avg 0.04"; it also stays very close to 0 throughout all layers, closely overlapping with the orange line and showing minimal variation across the entire layer range.
model_annotations.German: Dieses Diagramm trägt den Titel „Hidden State Mean" und zeigt die mittleren Absolutwerte von Hidden States über die Schichten eines Modells hinweg, wobei drei verschiedene Zustände verglichen werden: vor dem Gating, nach dem Gating und die Baseline. Die x-Achse ist mit „Layer" beschriftet, verwendet eine lineare Skala und erstreckt sich von 0 bis etwa 22, mit Tick-Beschriftungen bei 0, 5, 10, 15 und 20. Die y-Achse ist mit „Abs Mean" beschriftet, verwendet ebenfalls eine lineare Skala und reicht von 0 bis etwa 4,5, mit Tick-Beschriftungen bei 0, 1, 2, 3 und 4. Die erste Linie, dargestellt in Blau mit gestricheltem Linienstil und dreieckigen Markierungen, repräsentiert den „Hidden state mean before gate" mit einem angegebenen Durchschnitt von 0.71. Diese Linie beginnt bei Layer 0 nahe einem Wert von etwa 0,1, steigt dann ab Layer 5 deutlich an und erreicht einen Spitzenwert von etwa 4,5 bei Layer 7, fällt danach auf etwa 2,0 bei Layer 10 ab, steigt erneut auf etwa 2,5 bei Layer 12 und zeigt anschließend einen allgemein abnehmenden Trend mit Schwankungen bis auf etwa 0,5 bei Layer 22. Die zweite Linie, dargestellt in Orange mit durchgezogenem Linienstil und kreisförmigen Markierungen, repräsentiert den „Hidden state mean after gate" mit einem angegebenen Durchschnitt von 0.05. Diese Linie verläuft nahezu durchgehend nahe bei 0 über alle Layer hinweg, mit nur minimalen Schwankungen, und bleibt von Layer 0 bis Layer 22 bei Werten knapp über 0. Die dritte Linie, dargestellt in Grün mit durchgezogenem Linienstil und ohne deutlich erkennbare Markierungen, repräsentiert den „Hidden state mean of baseline" mit einem angegebenen Durchschnitt von 0.04. Auch diese Linie verläuft über alle Layer hinweg nahe bei 0 und zeigt ein sehr ähnliches Muster wie die orangefarbene Linie, wobei die Werte von Layer 0 bis Layer 22 konstant niedrig bleiben.
